method: Independent inspection of the original padded PNG, not a source page, answer key, or previous FigureSpec.
composition: One unframed monochrome centrifuge apparatus on a white padded canvas. A horizontal rod carries one dark cylinder on the left and two joined light cylinders on the right. A central vertical shaft extends below the rod. A curved rotation arrow wraps the lower shaft.

objects.fact: One dark, squat cylindrical body at the left; the rod projects beyond it.
One light horizontal cylinder to the right of the shaft, with its left circular end visible in perspective.
A second light horizontal cylinder immediately joins the first; the seam is visible and the rod projects beyond the outer end.
A horizontal support rod runs through the mounted bodies and crosses the central shaft.
A vertical shaft descends from the rod through the shared inner radius-dimension reference and below the rotation arrow; its lower extension also supplies the central dimension witness.
A curved arrow encircles the lower shaft, indicating rotation, not force.
A vertical outer witness descends from the steel body's reference position to below the left dimension line.
A vertical outer witness descends at the join/reference position of the two aluminum bodies to below the right dimension line.
The left horizontal dimension connects the steel witness to the central shaft reference.
The right horizontal dimension connects the central shaft reference to the aluminum witness; it is visibly longer than the left dimension.
The left dimension's outer head points left toward the steel witness.
The left dimension's inner head points right toward the shared central reference.
The right dimension's inner head points left toward the shared central reference.
The right dimension's outer head points right toward the aluminum witness.
The Chinese material label 钢 appears above the left cylinder.
The Chinese material label 铝 appears above the joined right cylinders.
The symbol r with subscript 2 appears above the short left dimension.
The symbol r with subscript 1 appears above the long right dimension.

relationships: Both aluminum cylinders share the horizontal rod axis and touch at one join.
The central vertical shaft intersects the horizontal rod between the left body and right bodies.
The left and right radius dimensions share the shaft reference; their outer endpoints lie on the corresponding material-reference witnesses.
The aluminum pair's join/reference lies farther from the shaft than the steel reference.
Each radius dimension has outward-facing arrowheads at both ends.
The curved arrow is associated with the lower shaft and rotation only.
absent: No numerical distances, mass values, ratios, or answer-bearing 3 and 3/2 annotations.
No force vectors, force labels, axes, grid, solution text, or kilogram-prototype depiction.
No second subfigure or printed figure caption in this original PNG.
modernRegularizationSeparateFromSource: English Steel and Aluminum replace the Chinese material labels.
